notes.startup: Playwright process launch to visible Welcome. Fresh or reused disposable profile. OS caches untouched.
notes.rss: Sum of per-process resident sets, including Electron descendants and profile-marked helpers. Shared pages may be counted repeatedly.
notes.footprint: Sum of macOS kernel phys_footprint ledger charges for the same process family. Attributed process charges, not a de-duplicated measurement of physical RAM.
notes.cpu: Percent of one logical core. Delta of own-process kernel user and system CPU time, with ps CPU-time fallback. Short-lived compiler CPU is also read from main-process reaped child counters.
notes.typing: Chromium keydown to second animation callback, with visible content and autosave verified. Excludes OS input delivery and physical display presentation.
notes.stages: One 650-line plain-text fixture per note, one native C source, and 40 subfolders of 25 files each. Stages are cumulative within one process, and memory snapshots are post-settle.
notes.targetUnits: Provisional budgets use decimal MB. Raw measurements report bytes for footprint and MiB for RSS.
